error.provider.invalid_credential: This API key isn't valid. Check that you copied it completely, or enter a different one in the key settings.

error.provider.quota_exhausted: Your provider says this key has no credit or quota left. Add credit with your provider, or enter a different key in the key settings.

onboarding.title: Let's get to know you
onboarding.intro: Tarjuman explains one language in another. Tell it which ones, and a little about you, so the answers fit.
onboarding.mediation.hint: The language Tarjuman writes its explanations in.
onboarding.error.same_language: The language you're learning must be different from the explanation language: Tarjuman explains one language using another.
onboarding.error.invalid: Some of these answers aren't valid yet. Check them and try again.
onboarding.level.label: Your level
onboarding.level.hint: A rough guess is fine. Answers get simpler or harder to match it.
onboarding.interests.label: Add an interest
onboarding.interests.hint: Optional. Examples will use these topics when they fit.
onboarding.interests.error.blank: Write an interest before adding it.
onboarding.interests.error.too_long: That interest is too long. Keep it under 60 characters.
onboarding.interests.error.too_many: You can add up to 10 interests.
level.A1.description: Beginner: I know a few words and basic phrases
level.A2.description: Elementary: I can handle simple everyday situations
level.B1.description: Intermediate: I can talk about familiar topics
level.B2.description: Upper intermediate: I can follow and join most conversations
level.C1.description: Advanced: I use the language fluently and flexibly
level.C2.description: Proficient: I understand almost everything with ease
key.title: Your API key
key.intro: Tarjuman uses your own key to talk to the AI service. The key goes only to that service, and is never shown here again.
key.label: API key
key.mode.legend: Where should the key be kept?
key.mode.persistent_hint: You won't need to enter it again. It is stored encrypted in this browser, but anyone who can use this browser profile could use it.
key.mode.session_hint: Safer on a shared computer. The key is forgotten when you close or reload the page, so you'll enter it again next time.
key.storage_unavailable: Tarjuman can't save data in this browser right now (for example in a private window), so the key and your conversations won't be kept after you close the page. You can still continue for this session only.
conversations.label: Conversations
conversations.delete_confirm: Delete "{title}" and all its messages? This can't be undone.
chat.label: Chat
chat.composer.label: Message
chat.empty: Ask anything about the language you're learning.
chat.interrupted: This answer was interrupted and may be incomplete.
app.boot_failed: Tarjuman couldn't start. Reload the page. If it keeps happening, check that your browser allows this site to store data.
refusal.out_of_scope: Tarjuman helps you learn languages, so I can't help with that. I can explain a word, a grammar point, or how to say something in the language you're learning. What would you like to know?
refusal.translation_not_pedagogical: I translate to help you learn, not to replace your own writing. Ask me how to say something in the language you're learning and I'll explain the words and the structure.
